subject: banshee-haven
q: Where are Banshee Haven's ten bathrooms, and what are its rooms?
detail:
Ghost Haven has thirty-one rooms filed and a full appendix. Specter Haven has seventeen. Banshee Haven has NONE. What is known: the wings are RIBS, each one sitting under a titty; the only entrance is the LEFT TITTY, which is Elspeth's kitchen; and there are ten bathrooms whose locations Bell has not told anyone.

ANSWERED IN PART, 7 SEPTEMBER. Maribel's own Appendix v0 gave sixteen rooms and the whole architecture. THE TEN BATHROOMS ARE STILL UNLOCATED and Bell has still not told anyone. See c-banshee-architecture. RETIRED pending the updated appendix.
